rules.long_run_progression: +1 to 1.5 mi per build week; +2 mi only when rebuilding to a distance already run; down week every 4th
rules.time_cap: about 11.5 min per mile; on hills stop at the cap even if short of the miles

Easy (RPE 3-4).note: Provisional from the 25:30-28:00 5K bracket. Reset after the 8 Nov 10K.

Strides.note: About 5K effort, smooth, not a sprint

Climbing (RPE 6-7).note: Run or power-hike uphill; jog or walk down

exercises.name: Romanian deadlift (barbell)
exercises.sets: 2 warm-up, top set 1 x 4-6 (140 kg), 2 x 6-8 at 125 kg

exercises.name: Bench press (flat barbell)
exercises.note: Add 2.5-5 kg when all three sets hit 10

exercises.name: Dumbbell step-up (HEAVY)
exercises.sets: 1 warm-up + 3 x 6 per side, 30 kg total
exercises.note: Quad strength, in from week 1. Box at knee height. Add 5-10 kg when all sets are clean

exercises.name: Walking lunge (dumbbells)
exercises.sets: 1 warm-up + 3 x 20 m (10 steps per leg), 40 kg total

exercises.name: Step-down
exercises.sets: 2 x 10 per side, 15 kg, 3 s lowering

exercises.name: Weighted pull-up + weighted dip (existing pairing)
exercises.sets: 1 warm-up + 3 x 5-8 pull-ups (12/16/16 kg), 3 x 8-12 dips (12 kg)

exercises.name: Seated incline curl + barbell skullcrusher (existing pairing)
Copenhagen plank
exercises.note: Short lever for the first 4 weeks

exercises.name: Weighted decline crunch
exercises.note: Replaces the ab wheel on this day

exercises.name: Stair climber (finisher)
exercises.sets: Minutes per the week table, max 20
exercises.note: RPE 4-5 unless the table says intervals

exercises.name: Pull-up (bodyweight)
exercises.note: Add load once all three sets reach 8

exercises.name: Hanging leg raise + ab wheel (existing pairing)

lift_modes.reduced: Same exercises. Keep the top set on RDL, bench, incline, pull-up and row at full load; drop one set from everything else; stop 2 reps short. Down weeks, re-entry and race weeks.
lift_modes.heavy: Same exercises. Mon: RDL 3 x 3-5, bench 3 x 5, barbell row 3 x 6, heavy step-up 3 x 5 per side, lunges 2 x 20 m; accessories as written. Wed: weighted pull-ups 4 x 4-6 + dips, incline 3 x 5-6; arms, laterals and the rest as written. Weeks 28-39.
lift_modes.short: Full Body #3 minus hip abduction/adduction and minus one set from every other exercise (about 45 min). Chest fly, hammer curl, laterals, pull-ups and row stay. Used once the long run passes about 2.5 h.
lift_modes.taper: Same exercises, about half the sets, one heavy top set per main lift. No lower-body loading in race week.
lift_modes.upper: Full Body #1 without RDL, step-ups, lunges and step-downs (day after the marathon).
lift_modes.hotel: USA: whatever the hotel gym has. Pull-ups or hangs, push-ups or dumbbell press, rows, curls, laterals, split squats, calf and tibialis raises, Copenhagen plank. Maintain, don't progress.
